_usage: Corrections the ingest heuristics cannot make. 'files': globs over paths relative to the domain lake (forward slashes) -> {"parser": "report" | "sniff", "merge_continuations": true to append blank-line-separated rows to the table above}. 'tables': final table name -> {"columns": {old: new}, "rename_to": new table name, "reason": why}. Each correction is recorded in the table's notes.

SN_y_tot_V2_0.reason: the SILSO yearly file has no header; names follow the SILSO SN_y_tot_V2.0 format description (-1 means not available; marker 1 = definitive)
